name: AK18B - Pocket Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC), Wall Mountable, 39g
highlights: Occupancy and Off-Gassing, Pocket Sized — CO₂ shows how many people the ventilation is failing to keep up with; TVOC shows what the room's materials and cleaning products are adding. Two readings, 39 g.
Small Enough to Be Carried, Not Just Sited — A monitor left at home measures one room. One that fits in a pocket measures every room someone walks into.
Colour Status on Both Channels — Each reading carries its own band, so the screen answers the question without being read closely.
500 mAh, USB-C — About an hour to charge; roughly six hours of standby.
100 Per Carton — Same enclosure and packing as the rest of the AK18 range — five sensor configurations, one carton spec.
